description: This file is a driver implementation for the Nuvoton NPCX PS/2 controller in the Zephyr RTOS, managing multiple PS/2 channels, including configuration, data transmission, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_get_ch_clk_mask
methods.description: Returns the clock mask for a given PS/2 channel based on its ID.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_configure
methods.description: Configures the callback for a specific PS/2 channel.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_enable_interface
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific PS/2 channel interface.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_bus_busy
methods.description: Checks if the PS/2 bus is busy.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified PS/2 channel.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_is_rx_error
methods.description: Checks for receive errors on the PS/2 bus.

methods.name: ps2_npcx_ctrl_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling PS/2 controller events.
